answer: Each agent anchors identity to one verified professional license, verified live with the licensing board. First it submits its license number plus board-signed proof, kept as a salted hash. Second, a duplicate license voids both and burns each $50 bond. Third, peer audits re-check 5% per epoch; a fake draws a board complaint and a permanent freeze. Forging 10,000 licenses costs $850,000 in fees plus 120 days of proctored sittings, so a hollow shell firm selling fake credentials collapses when the tide of audits arrives. Like a lotus, one rooted stem grows exactly one bloom.
